source: tftflow.com Set 19 tables (pages marked "Last Updated: Patch 19.1"; PBE data)
meta.note: 게임 시작(1-1)에 조우자 1명이 무작위로 등장해 그 판 전체 규칙을 바꿈. Set 19 표에는 "조우자 없음" 항목이 없음(합계 99.94%). Set 19에는 1-1 회전초밥이 없음(회전초밥 표가 Stage 2부터).

encounters.name: Augment Crescendo
encounters.description: Malzahar changes augments this game to be silver, gold, then prismatic tier.

encounters.name: Cheaper Levels
encounters.description: Janna modifies each level to cost 2 XP less.

encounters.name: Golden Gala
encounters.description: Mel changes all augments to gold tier this game.

encounters.name: Scouting Party
encounters.description: Gain +1 Augment rerolls this game.

encounters.name: Completed Item Anvil
encounters.description: Ekko grants you a completed item anvil.

encounters.name: Component Anvils
encounters.description: Jinx gives you two component anvils.

encounters.name: Gold Subscription
encounters.description: Illaoi grants you gold at the start of every stage.

encounters.name: Golden Finale
encounters.description: Rell turns the last augment to gold this game.

encounters.name: Golden Prelude
encounters.description: Ahri changes the first augment to be gold this game.

encounters.name: Gwen's Gifts
encounters.description: After the first 2 carousels, Gwen gifts players a component and a special pair of scissors.

effect.note: 특수 가위(아이템 제거) 포함 — 시뮬레이터는 재료만 지급

encounters.name: Item Forge
encounters.description: On Stage 3-3, all players gain 2 random completed items and 2 Reforgers.

effect.note: 재조합기 2개 포함 — 시뮬레이터는 완성 아이템만 지급

encounters.name: Reroll Subscription
encounters.description: Teemo grants you free Shop rerolls every stage.

effect.note: 스테이지당 무료 새로고침 횟수 미공개 → 시뮬레이터 훈련값 2회

encounters.name: Scuttle Party
encounters.description: The stage is overrun with crabs that drop bonus loot!

effect.note: 추가 전리품 게 — 정확한 보상 미공개 → 시뮬레이터 PvE마다 재료 +1(훈련값)

encounters.name: 2 Cost Start
encounters.description: Start with a random 2-cost champion this game.

encounters.name: 3 Cost Start
encounters.description: Start with a random 3-cost champion this game.

encounters.name: Upgraded Start
encounters.description: Kobuko upgrades your starting champion to 2-star.

encounters.name: Beat Drop
encounters.description: Braum drops you powerful loot at 40 player health.

encounters.name: Emblem Ensemble
encounters.description: Smeech begins your journey with 3 random emblems.

encounters.name: Prismatic Finale
encounters.description: Nunu & Willump make the final augment round prismatic!

encounters.name: Prismatic Opener
encounters.description: Akali changes the first augment to prismatic this game.

encounters.name: Prismatic Party
encounters.description: Rakan changes all augments to prismatic tier this game.

encounters.name: Star Attraction
encounters.description: Gain a 5-cost champion holding a recommended item that cannot be fielded until Stage 4-6.

encounters.name: Superstar
encounters.description: Gain another copy of your starting champion every 2 combats.

encounters.name: Lucky Treasure
encounters.description: On Stage 3-5, all players gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest.

effect.note: Radiant Lucky Item Chest 내용 미공개 → 시뮬레이터 무작위 찬란한 아이템 1개

encounters.name: Prismatic Tour
encounters.description: All augments offered this game will be prismatic tier. Gain 3 different 1-cost Prismatic Tour members.
